business_problem: Alta needed a transactable Google Cloud Marketplace path for its AI and technology spend management platform without pulling its product team off core forecasting work, while also helping finance and IT leaders understand fast-growing AI costs, usage, ownership, and ROI.
solution_summary: Alta uses Google Cloud to package both its Gemini-powered spend intelligence product and a fully transactable marketplace buying flow. Alta's core platform brings SaaS, cloud, hardware, and AI investment data into one system of record so finance and IT leaders can track cost, usage, ownership, and ROI in one place. Gemini supplies the intelligence layer that learns how an organization operates and turns that context into cost-saving guidance, more accurate forecasts, and board-ready summaries. To sell the product through Google Cloud Marketplace, Premier Cloud built an automated checkout service on Cloud Run that processes orders in the background and calls Google Partner Procurement APIs as the transaction bridge. Cloud SQL stores customer order records, while Cloud Pub/Sub sends plan event notifications so buyers can complete purchases online with existing Google Cloud credits and start using the software quickly.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud Marketplace
solution_components.role: Provides the transactable storefront where enterprise buyers review quotes, sign agreements, and purchase Alta with committed cloud spend.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Powers Alta's core intelligence capabilities for cost savings, more accurate forecasts, and executive-ready summaries.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Runs the automated checkout service that processes marketplace orders in the background without manual server management.

solution_components.name: Google Partner Procurement APIs
solution_components.role: Connect the checkout flow to Google procurement systems so buyers can transact with pre-committed Google Cloud credits.

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Stores customer order records for the marketplace transaction workflow.

solution_components.name: Cloud Pub/Sub
solution_components.role: Sends instant notifications when a customer buys, changes, or cancels a plan.

data_flow: Technology-spend, usage, ownership, and ROI data from customers' SaaS, cloud, hardware, and AI environments feeds Alta's platform, where Gemini generates forecasts, savings guidance, and board-ready summaries. When a buyer purchases through Google Cloud Marketplace, the checkout service running on Cloud Run calls Google Partner Procurement APIs, writes order records to Cloud SQL, and uses Cloud Pub/Sub to trigger plan-change notifications and onboarding actions.
business_outcome: Alta launched a fully transactable Google Cloud Marketplace listing in four weeks instead of the typical eight-plus, avoided pulling 125 engineering hours and 60 project management hours away from its roadmap, enabled buyers to use existing Google Cloud credits, and extended its Gemini-powered platform for cost savings, forecasting, and executive reporting.
